clock_and_cpu.null_observer: Safe-call assignments do not evaluate RHS when receiver is null; no probe/clock/record allocation on the disabled path.
clock_and_cpu.cpu_guard: Both endpoint CPU samples and their difference must be nonnegative, and sampled Linux thread IDs equal; otherwise JSON null.
clock_and_cpu.cpu_scope: Cumulative sampled-thread CPU, not exclusive coroutine CPU.
clock_and_cpu.admission_and_preparation: Includes preparation transactions, yields, Room scheduling/admission; not isolated SQL lock waiting.
clock_and_cpu.query_and_digest: Ready callback entry to original final map; metadata queries, filtering and digest updates.
clock_and_cpu.hex_and_result: Original SHA finalization, Formatter and result allocation in unchanged execution order; not a Formatter-only timer.

observer_and_cancellation: Per-repository volatile nullable observer is captured once per call; default null.
Callback invoked only after successful SpatialIndex.read return outside its transaction; no catch swallowing production failures, callback failures or cancellation.
Tile opts in only for timed local append, collects to CopyOnWriteArrayList, resets observer in finally before forced full rendering.
JSON construction and status output remain outside append timing at the original evidence point.

counter_boundaries.preparationRows: Sum of existing BuildBatch rows; may contain hints/cuts or repeated identities, not unique strokes.
counter_boundaries.nativeStrokeBuilds: Existing lastBuild getter reflected outside timing; if baseline getter absent, field is omitted, never zero-filled.

baseline_patch_receipt.review_mode: Read saved root receipt only; did not apply patch or rehash entire baseline.

native_conclusion: No diagnostic native timing or root-cause conclusion. Diagnostic-on measurements include observation overhead and do not replace default-off performance results.
